channel.title: Reps. Greg Stanton & Michael Lawler Discuss Extreme Heat & Climate Change
channel.desc: Co-Chairs of the Congressional Extreme Heat Caucus, Reps. Greg Stanton (D-AZ) and Mike Lawler (R-NY) discuss ways to protect the U.S. against extreme heat. The Center for Strategic & International Studies hosts this event.
